exclusions.reason: The only success is a 302 redirect to a signed recording URL. The connection transport deliberately refuses cross-origin redirects before exposing a response, so this binary recording cannot be represented as an ordinary REST result.

The pinned first-party 2.15 contract documents only 401, 404, and default error responses for this route. With no success status or response shape, there is no first-party authority for a callable result contract.

synthetic_path_args.reason: The first-party path template contains this placeholder but declares the same required value only as a query parameter; the path token is exposed separately so runtime interpolation cannot leave an unresolved marker.
